::: {#hero-heading}
<div class="h1">Hey, I'm happy you're here</div>

Thanks for stopping by! 

I work as a research assistant at the [NTID Research Center on Culture and Language](https://www.rit.edu/ntid/research-center-culture-and-language) at the Rochester Institute of Technology. My research intrests inlcude utilizing data 
to improve educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students.

My current project with the NTID Research Center on Culture and Language aims to develop standardized assestment tools in American Sign Language to evaulate and screen for Alzheimer's disease and dementia in Deaf and Hard of Hearing Older Adults. Learn more about our work [here](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/41642783/). 

Connect with me on [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/emmamkane).

:::

## About me

::: {.grid}

::: {.g-col-6 #about-me-1}

Passionate about how we can apply data to improve educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students during transition points 

I enjoy working with data to answer questions that can help improve educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students. I am particularly interested in how we can use data to improve decision-making during transition points, such as the transition points across the K-12 pipeline, and how can we use data to improve the educational outcomes for Deaf and Hard of Hearing students.  

:::

::: {.g-col-6 #about-me-2}

** Educational background and experience **

I earned my B.S in Public Policy from the Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT) in 2026 and am currently working on my M.B.A with a concentration in Data Anlaytiucs and Mangement from RIT. I have experience working with data in various settings, including research, education, and community organizations. 


:::
